content.comment_body: Hello, Can the counter value be manually adjusted, including subtraction? I have a program using an optical sensor, where the counter increases when the value changes from 0 to 1. I added a button for manual increments—can I do the same for decrements? For example, if the counter displays 20, I want to use a button to subtract 1 and show 19 instead of 20.

Thank you, that solution works well. My next question: is it possible to save the current counter value before performing a reset? I am using [product_name] Web Editor and added a reset button. I want the pre-reset value to be shown in the interface for the operator to see. Is this achievable?
Yes, this can be done. Note that the counter value needs to be less than 32,768.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are looking to gain direct control over counter values in their automation workflow, including both increasing and decreasing values using interface buttons. There is also interest in retaining and displaying the counter value prior to reset for better operator awareness. The responses confirm these features can be implemented, with an important restriction on the maximum storable pre-reset value.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to use buttons for both addition and subtraction of counter values, and also to display the previous counter value to operators when the reset function is triggered.
